name: Rug Rails
hook: Outrun the rug. Bank the bag.
tagline: The first skill game in the lab: a hoodie frog sprints down three neon subway lanes, swerving, jumping and sliding past sell walls, KYC gates and the Exit Scam Express while scooping shitcoins into a bag the Taxman wants. Cash out to hover off the rails with it before the round rolls them up like a carpet.
